items.title: Vanessa Kerry appointed WHO Director-General’s Special Envoy for Health Resilience
items.summary: WHO appointed Dr Vanessa Kerry as the Director-General’s Special Envoy for Health Resilience, expanding her earlier role on climate change and health.
items.whyImportant: The appointment reflects WHO’s focus on resilient, integrated and sustainably financed health systems amid climate and emergency risks.
keyFacts: Role: Special Envoy for Health Resilience
